recipes.name: psd_alldata
recipes.description: The USDA FAS PSD all-commodities file, snapshot of 2026-11-17, every column as published but typed: one row per commodity, country, market year and attribute.

steps.name: extract_csv
steps.description: Check that the zip is the 2026-11-17 snapshot (its SHA-256), and extract psd_alldata.csv from it.

steps.name: type_and_sort
steps.description: Check the CSV's header, read every column with a fixed type (codes stay zero-padded strings, years and months become integers, Value a number), sort by the key, and check the snapshot's known facts.

recipes.name: commodity_attribute
recipes.description: Every attribute PSD reports for each commodity, with its unit, as published: one row per commodity and attribute pair in the 2026-11-17 snapshot.

steps.name: list_pairs
steps.description: List each commodity and attribute pair once, with the descriptions and unit as PSD publishes them, and check that every row of psd_alldata finds its pair.

recipes.name: world_balance
recipes.description: Every country in the 2026-11-17 PSD snapshot summed to a world total: one row per commodity, market year and attribute, leaving out rates and ratios.

steps.name: sum_countries
steps.description: Sum Value over every country as exact decimals, with no country dropped or adjusted, count the countries with a nonzero value, leave out the rates and ratios that cannot be summed, and check that nothing is lost in the sum and that the world balances wherever its countries do.
